Name: Alternate Anthro Sabrina- Anthro Characters Continued Sebastian Genderswap Add-on
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
I've kitbashed together Male-to-Female Genderswap sprites and portraits for Sebasitan/Sabrina  from the Anthro Characters Continued mod. I completed Alex/Alexis in another mod and I plan on continuing on to Shane/Shauna after this.

I started this project before the "official" genderswaps came out, but now, the genderswaps are actually already out. However, I completed this just to use the already-made portraits.

I mashed them together through Alex's original sprites from Sion9000/Gaveliere, the portraits created from  BetasEnjoyer11 (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/5082) , AdarinSinner's Sebastian_GIRL mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/463) and the clothing and bodies is from Ironzelly's Seasonal Outfits (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450). All of these either have open permissions or I have recieved permission to use.

All portraits and sprites are complete. The mod is effectively finished. Sprites ended up kinda caked up but I kept it that way because I felt it looked good.

Now that this project is complete, I plan on wrapping my three designs together into a single, larger, Content Patch-based mod, as well as finding some fan NPCs to park any existing unused designs.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Download and install Anthro Characters Continued
2. Download this mod, unzip it, and place the folder inside into the Same Directory as your original Anthro Characters Continued patch. Accept Overwrites.

[b]Shout outs[/b]
BetasEnjoyer11 provided made the original portraits and gave me the original copies of them and let me use them!

Downloads.Description: All sprites remade to include no content I am disallowed to use.
